review.brief_reason: The proposed simplification changes sqrt(Abs(...)) to sqrt(sin(...)) inside the x1*x2*Min(...) term, which alters values on the common domain. Counterexample: x0=0, x1=1, x2=1, x3=0. Original inner: sqrt(Abs(sin(pi*sin(pi*Min(0.4275...,sqrt(Abs(1))))))) = sqrt(Abs(sin(pi*sin(pi*1)))) = sqrt(Abs(sin(pi*sin(pi)))) ≈ sqrt(0.9505) ≈ 0.9749. Proposed inner: sqrt(sin(pi*sin(pi*Min(0.4275...,sqrt(Abs(1)))))) = sqrt(sin(pi*sin(pi*1))) = sqrt(sin(pi*sin(pi))) ≈ sqrt(0.9505) ≈ 0.9749 (same here). But at x2=0.5: original sqrt(Abs(sin(pi*sin(pi*Min(0.4275...,sqrt(0.5)))))) vs proposed sqrt(sin(pi*sin(pi*Min(0.4275...,sqrt(0.5))))). When the inner sin is negative, Abs makes it positive but proposed takes sqrt of negative = undefined, changing domain and values. At x2=2: Min(0.4275, sqrt(2))=0.4275, sin(pi*sin(pi*0.4275))≈sin(pi*0.9724)≈sin(3.054)≈0.0872>0, both same. But at x2≈0.3: sqrt(0.3)=0.5477>0.4275 so Min=0.4275, same. Need x2 where sqrt(x2)<0.4275, i.e. x2<0.1828. At x2=0.1: sqrt(0.1)=0.3162, sin(pi*0.3162)=sin(0.9934)=0.8382, sin(pi*0.8382)=sin(2.633)=-0.4856. Original: sqrt(Abs(-0.4856))=0.6968. Proposed: sqrt(-0.4856) is not real. Domain contraction with value change on common domain.
review.counterexample: x0=0, x1=1, x2=0.1, x3=0: original term uses sqrt(Abs(sin(...)))=sqrt(0.4856)=0.6968 (real), proposed uses sqrt(sin(...))=sqrt(-0.4856) which is not real-valued, altering the common domain and values.
